meta.target: honest Rasch difficulty (harness.oracle_maps), mean over 5 subject folds; strong-tier Rasch b (pairs with ability >= the parent's median) reported, never trained on

_meta.input: out-of-fold predictions, standardised within benchmark (harness.eval_covariate); B0 term on raw x

verdict.rule: GO only if the primary (finetuned) has held-out Pearson r >= 0.3 against honest difficulty on >= 3 of 4 parents AND a nested test-like ALC difference <= -0.002 on transferred nested or per-pair nested; otherwise KILL
